children: The Trust posted a decline in net assets from operations, compared with a gain a year earlier, as a palladium-price valuation loss and realized losses on palladium distributed for redemptions outweighed gains on unsettled creations or redemptions. Its NAV increased 7.82% during the quarter, supported by an increase in outstanding Shares.
² Reported as “Change in net assets from operations”.
: Increased 7.82% in the quarter, from $591.1M at June 30, 2026 to $637.3M at September 30, 2026.
: Rose 0.16%, from $1,220.00 per ounce at June 30, 2026 to $1,222.00 at September 30, 2026.
: 3,650,000 Shares were created and 1,562,500 Shares were redeemed during the quarter.
: Remained at $22.10 from June 30 to September 30, 2026; the Sponsor’s Fee was $996,838 for the quarter.
